name: glob
description: List files and directories matching a glob pattern. `**` matches any number of directory levels, so `**/*.py` finds every Python file in the tree and `**/*` lists the whole tree. Directories come back with a trailing separator. Says so explicitly when nothing matches.

pattern.description: Glob pattern, relative to the working directory unless it is absolute. Supports *, ?, [...] within one path segment and ** across segments.

name: grep
description: Search text using a regular expression.

name: read_file
description: Read a whole file up to 100k bytes.

name: read_bytes
description: Read an inclusive byte range from a file.

name: read_lines
description: Read an inclusive line range from a file.

name: edit_file
description: Replace an exact string in a file atomically.

name: apply_patch
description: Apply a unified patch to the working tree.

name: write_file
description: Create a new file; refuse to overwrite an existing file.

name: bash
description: Run a Bash script with GNU Bash on Linux. The script is written to a file and run; the call waits up to wait_seconds (default 5, maximum 30) and returns its output if it finishes. Otherwise it keeps running as a background job, the call returns its job id and output so far, and the full result is delivered automatically when it finishes.

wait_seconds.description: Seconds to wait inline, clamped to 0..30; 0 backgrounds immediately. Defaults to 5.

warn_after_seconds.description: Seconds before one warning to the agent that started the job; defaults to 60. Disabled when not greater than wait_seconds.

name: python
description: Run a script with the managed scientific Python environment (numpy, scipy, pandas, matplotlib, sympy, rebound, astropy, skyfield, jplephem). The script is written to a file and run; the call waits up to wait_seconds (default 5, maximum 30) and returns its output if it finishes. Otherwise it keeps running as a background job, the call returns its job id and output so far, and the full result is delivered automatically when it finishes.

wait_seconds.description: Seconds to wait inline, clamped to 0..30; 0 backgrounds immediately. Defaults to 5.

warn_after_seconds.description: Seconds before one warning to the agent that started the job; defaults to 60. Disabled when not greater than wait_seconds.

name: job
description: Manage jobs with action list, read, or kill. job_id is required for read and kill.

name: launch_subagent
description: Launch one child and return immediately. Native agents may launch one child at each of the first two depths; a depth-2 child cannot launch anything. Choose a relevant title made of three words joined by hyphens (for example inspect-api-cache); this is guidance only and is not enforced. A depth-1 child may use the configured child model. A depth-2 child must receive a non-empty real model string or managed short name. The optional harness selects native, Codex, or Claude Code. Do not wait or poll: results arrive as mandatory mid-turn steers at the next API/tool call boundary, or wake an idle parent. In-flight work finishes and its output is retained.

harness.description: Harness for the child. Omit for the native slbh provider; use codex or claude_code for a native harness leaf.

model.description: Real provider model ID or a managed short name. Required and non-empty for every depth-2 child; depth 1 may use the configured child default.

title.description: A relevant three-word dashed title chosen by the parent, such as inspect-api-cache. Guidance only; not enforced.

warn_after_seconds.description: Seconds before the parent receives one warning that this child is still running; defaults to 5.

name: msg_subagent
description: Send a mandatory mid-turn steer to any agent in this runtime, including your parent or siblings. FIFO delivery at the next API/tool call boundary; wakes idle recipients. Never waits for turn completion or cancels in-flight work.
